meta.title: Dad's Note for the Bicycle Ride

paragraphs: Tom, this note is for your bicycle journey to Green Hill. You and Ben go to Grandma and Grandpa's house on Saturday. You leave at eight o'clock in the morning. It is a long ride, so read my directions two times. Put on your helmet before you begin. Ben must wear his helmet too. Be careful all the way. The weather is good on Saturday. Grandma and Grandpa are happy to see you.

Begin at the park gate. Ride on the bike path for ten minutes. The path is flat and easy. You see many trees on both sides. At the market, turn right. Next, ride on the big road, but stay at the side. Go slowly, and ride one behind the other. If you hear an ambulance, stop at the side and wait. Then ride on again. Never stop in the middle of the road.

After the big road, you come to a hill. The hill is the worst part of the journey. Do not ride up it. Walk with your bicycle, and stop when you are tired. The sun is hot, so drink some water there. The hill is not very long. At the top you can see a white sign. The sign says "GREEN HILL." Grandma's house is the second house on the right. It has a blue gate.
Do you have water in your bag, Tom? Take a hat and a small snack too. Grandpa waits at the gate at ten o'clock. Grandma has lunch for you. Say hello to them from me. Have a good ride! Dad
